sources.title: Goldstone Boson Decays and Chiral Anomalies

evidence.text: Analyze a three-current Green function with one global axial and two gauge currents. Track loop-momentum-routing ambiguities, impose gauge-current conservation, and separate the anomaly from the classical fermionic mass contribution and the axion contribution to the full nonlinear current.

sources.title: Axion-gauge coupling quantization with a twist

evidence.text: The perturbative argument integrates out fermions and uses explicit SU(3) dimensions, Dynkin indices and triality to establish an integrality condition representation by representation. The nonzero-triality case reduces to divisibility by 36 and elementary congruence cases.

sources.title: Non-standard axion electrodynamics and the dual Witten effect

evidence.text: Non-standard couplings are constructed by changing SL(2,Z) frame, adding an integer-quantized θF′∧F′ interaction, and transforming back. The appendix instead maps generalized Maxwell equations to a closed field strength and requires their monodromy matrix to lie in SL(2,Z).

sources.title: Goldstone Boson Decays and Chiral Anomalies

evidence.text: Review fermion-triangle decay diagrams using Dirac traces, Bose exchange, Feynman parameters and an expansion in inverse fermion mass. Match the leading amplitude onto a local aFμνF̃μν interaction.

sources.title: Axion-gauge coupling quantization with a twist

evidence.text: The nonperturbative argument constructs correlated color and electromagnetic fluxes on a four-torus with twisted boundary conditions. Their normalized integrals are ∫tr(G∧G)/(8π²)=2/3 and ∫F∧F/(8π²)=1; axion periodicity then constrains the path-integral phase.

sources.title: Non-standard axion electrodynamics and the dual Witten effect

evidence.text: The standard quantization argument uses integral magnetic flux, the even intersection pairing on spin four-manifolds, and invariance of the exponentiated Euclidean action under θ→θ+2π.

sources.title: Axion Periodicity and Coupling Quantization in the Presence of Mixing

evidence.text: Can mixing and decoupling turn periodic UV axions into noncompact IR scalars, relaxing coupling quantization or enlarging field ranges? Which apparent violations survive gauge invariance, anomaly cancellation and a careful definition of the low-energy field space?

sources.title: Electromagnetic Couplings of Axions

evidence.text: Must the dominant axion–photon interaction be quantized in units proportional to e²? The paper reexamines this argument, the relation between monopoles and axion mass, and experimental signatures of more general electromagnetic axion couplings.

sources.title: Axion domain walls, small instantons, and non-invertible symmetry breaking

evidence.text: How does the global form of a gauge group constrain axion couplings and domain walls, and when can ultraviolet small instantons break non-invertible shift symmetries sufficiently to remove vacuum degeneracy?

sources.title: Observational Constraints on Gauge Field Production in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: How strongly do CMB power spectra, bispectra and μ-distortion constrain gauge production through an axion–gauge coupling, and can Higgs-generated gauge masses provide an additional local non-Gaussian signal?

sources.title: Observational Constraints on Gauge Field Production in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Sourced scalar perturbations are treated with Green functions. The imported inverse-decay spectrum is Δ_R² = Δ_R,sr²[1 + Δ_R,sr² f₂(ξ)e^(4πξ)], with f₂ evaluated numerically. The massive extension uses a separate-universe δN estimate for conversion of Higgs fluctuations.

sources.title: Observational Constraints on Gauge Field Production in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Bispectrum bounds are estimated by projecting onto the constrained equilateral template, with shape cosine approximately 0.935 and an adopted volume ratio 5.3. μ-distortion is estimated analytically from dissipated scalar power, rather than a full Boltzmann evolution.

sources.title: Observational Constraints on Gauge Field Production in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Modified CAMB and COSMOMC compare spectra with WMAP7 and ACT using four MCMC chains and a target Gelman–Rubin R−1 < 0.01. Exact Whittaker gauge solutions extend numerical evaluation to ξ = 0; tensor contributions are included.
